_README.how_to_use: Fill fields marked USER. Leave AI fields (""/null) — I compute them. For each variant, paste the raw GA4 funnel exploration output into 'result' (the whole block, steps + counts + %). I parse the funnel steps, counts, and conversion from that text. Control = the variant named 'Control'.
_README.your_notes: Free-text per test. Your opinion/context — what you saw, which variant you lean toward shipping and why, gotchas, qual feedback. I weigh it in winner pick + insights + hypothesis. Leave "" to skip.
_README.goal_step: Name of the funnel step that counts as the conversion goal (e.g. 'Purchases'). Must match a step label in your pasted result.
_README.notes: aov = average order value in ৳ (from GA4). Set aov_override on a test only if that test's AOV differs from the month default.

aov_note: USER: paste June AOV from GA4
